issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction reporting broken internal links on the datatypes page, especially Attachment usage links to RelatedArtifact and ProdCharacteristic and Coding usage links to Meta, DataRequirement, and UsageContext.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies R4 commit a00b4aa155 and R5 commit ed006b5. Those commits updated the then-current Java publisher so generated datatype usage links used definitions.getSrcFile(...).html#... targets instead of assuming same-page anchors.
additional_context: The current checkout keeps datatypes.html in build scope with [%dtusage ...%] placeholders and active fhir.ini type-page mappings for Meta, RelatedArtifact, DataRequirement, UsageContext, and other datatype pages. ProdCharacteristic is commented out in fhir.ini and is not a current built datatype page target. The Java publisher source changed in 2019 is no longer present in this core checkout.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current rendered CI page links Attachment to metadatatypes.html#RelatedArtifact and Coding to resource.html#Meta, metadatatypes.html#DataRequirement, metadatatypes.html#UsageContext, and datatypes.html#Signature, and the checked target anchors exist.

related_jiras.note: The same 2019 commits also fixed STU3 comparison URL breakage for FHIR-20409, but that broader link issue was not necessary to decide for the datatypes-page audit.
